'''Sector Zerek''' was located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In [[137 ABY]], during the [[Skirmish at the Temple of the Sith|skirmish]] at the [[Temple of the Sith]], [[Fury-class starfighter|Sith Fury]] reinforcements were called in from Sector Zerek.
